statement: Meta has committed to deploying more than 1 gigawatt of capacity over the next 12 months, developed with Broadcom on design and TSMC on production.
why: A gigawatt-scale deployment commitment over one year is a direct read on hyperscaler capital intensity and the pull on power, cooling and packaging capacity.

impact.mechanism: Committed capacity additions convert into orders for accelerators, advanced packaging, electrical equipment and cooling across the next four quarters.

evidence.excerpt: Meta has committed to deploying over 1 gigawatt of capacity across the next 12 months, developed through partnerships with Broadcom (design) and TSMC (production).

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet relaying press reports; no company filing or guidance document behind the gigawatt figure.
